project_name: watermark2 — SemBind+ Semantic Watermark Defense & Robustness

research_goal.target_venue: CCF-A (ICML / NeurIPS / CVPR / IEEE S&P / CCS)
research_goal.direction: Defense-side semantic diffusion watermarking based on SemBind (ICML 2026)
research_goal.core_thesis: Existing semantic-bound diffusion watermarks (SemBind, SEAL, PGID, ISTS, Geometry) suffer from non-cryptographic feature collisions, majority-voting amplification, keyless public-backbone alignment bottlenecks, and spatial blindness. SemBind+ resolves these vulnerabilities via (M1) Keyed Orthogonal Codebook & All-or-Nothing Sub-block Checksum, (M2) Secret-Keyed Multi-Layer Patch-Attention Binding, and (M3) Single-Pass Mid-Trajectory Lookahead & Confidence-Weighted LLR Verification.

sembind_vulnerabilities: V1: Cross-image semantic hash collision (min Hamming 29/1024) + 64x256 majority-vote amplification causing 7.14% (2/28) black-box Imprint bypass.
V2: Public frozen DINOv2-giant [CLS] bottleneck allowing keyless adaptive feature-alignment bypass.
V3: Spatial patch blindness (all 256 patch tokens discarded), failing under regional splicing.
V4: Hard-sign binarization discontinuity (78/1024 flips under blur+resize), partial mask ratio sigma<1 leakage, and 2x NFE generation drift.

roadmap_stages.Stage_D1: Vulnerability Exposure Suite (V1 collision/voting analysis complete; V2 adaptive [CLS]-aligned Imprint attack & V3 regional splicing scripts next)
roadmap_stages.Stage_D2: SemBind+ Defense Implementation (M1 Keyed Orthogonal Codebook + Sub-block Checksum, M2 Keyed Multi-Layer Patch Binding, M3 Single-Pass Lookahead + Soft LLR)
roadmap_stages.Stage_D3: CCF-A 50-Pair Full Benchmark & Ablation Matrix vs GS, SemBind, PGID, SEAL, Geometry, ISTS, Sign-Clamping
